title: Towards a Measure Theory of Semantic Information
abstract: arXiv:2508.00525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A classic account of the quantification of semantic information is that of Bar-Hiller and Carnap. Their account proposes an inverse relation between the informativeness of a statement and its probability. However, their approach assigns the maximum informativeness to a contradiction: which Floridi refers to as the Bar-Hillel-Carnap paradox. He developed a novel theory founded on a distance metric and parabolic relation, designed to remove this paradox. Unfortunately is approach does not succeed in that aim.   In this paper I critique Floridi's theory of strongly semantic information on its own terms and show where it succeeds and fails. I then present a new approach based on the unit circle (a relation that has been the basis of theories from basic trigonometry to quantum theory). translated_title: 迈向语义信息的测度论
translated_abstract: 关于语义信息量化的经典论述来自Bar-Hiller和Carnap。他们的观点提出陈述的信息量与其概率之间呈反比关系。然而，他们的方法将最大信息量分配给了矛盾命题——Floridi将其称为Bar-Hillel-Carnap悖论。Floridi基于距离度量和抛物线关系开发了一种新理论，旨在消除这一悖论，但遗憾的是他的方法未能实现这一目标。本文从理论自身的角度对Floridi的强语义信息理论进行了批判性分析，指出了其成功与失败之处。随后，我提出了一种基于单位圆的新方法（单位圆这一关系一直是从基础三角学到量子理论等诸多理论的基础）。通过与von Neumann量子概率的类比，该方法被用于构建一个满足所有既定要求的信息量测度空间。
tldr: 本文批判了Floridi未能解决Bar-Hillel-Carnap悖论的强语义信息理论，并提出了一种基于单位圆和von Neumann量子概率类比的新方法，成功构建了信息量的测度空间。
